title: 第1035章 求锤得锤鬼仙的下场第1034章 当场撕破伪善面具
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
这两名幕后黑手，肚子里装的全是坏水，只剩心眼子是实的。
一听沈云的语气，他们便心知肚明：事情已然败露，等待他们的，将是万劫不复的灭顶之灾。
“方才生死关头，在下实在是一时糊涂、鬼迷心窍啊！”
玉虚圣子当场变脸，身躯猛地佝偻下来，点头哈腰：“求您看在仙尊的份上，饶过在下一次，今后我必定洗心革面，百倍偿还今日的罪孽。”
他实在是没招了，只能抬出玉虚仙尊的名号，不看僧面看佛面，企图让沈云高抬贵手。
另一边，万烬生也低下了高傲的头颅，连声开口道：“若在下没记错，这些死者与阁下素昧平生，你我之间并无深仇大恨。”
说到这里，他话锋一转，语气陡然郑重：“有件事，你恐怕还被蒙在鼓里，九霄仙尊此前曾亲自邀请万某，欲在帝陵之外暗算阁下！”
“只要今日放我一马，万某愿意弃暗投明，助你共同对付九霄仙尊，如何？”
没有永恒的朋友，只有永恒的利益。
万烬生深谙此道，企图用利益打动沈云，苟住这条小命。
不得不说，他的算盘打得极精——换作其他仙道大能，几个毫不相干的蝼蚁，哪里比得上除去大敌重要。
可惜，沈云是什么人？
他行事自有其道，岂会与鬼蜮之辈同流合污？
“待凌九霄准备好，我自会与他一决生死。”
沈云神色从容，深邃的目光投向天外，仿佛在说一件微不足道的小事：“圣门相助也好，神尊护佑也罢，此战过后，他的命运便到此为止了。”
昔日沈云羽翼未丰，还需要韬光养晦，与这尊绝世大敌周旋。
如今他大势已成，若还要靠这等下作手段取胜，干脆直接归隐山林算了，还修什么道？
“我也不难为你.....往后，便重新做回法宝吧。”
沈云大袖一拂，探手便朝万烬生抓去，干脆利落。
砰！

这位名列五杰、半步大罗的绝世天骄，连一个念头都来不及转动，整个人便被当场擒拿，如拎死狗般提溜在半空中。
“你到底要做什么？！”
万烬生满心仓惶，先前营造冷静形象瞬间粉碎，发出惊恐不安的诘问。
回应他的，唯有呼啸而至的造化仙火！
呼——呼——
刹那间，万烬生的圣躯、元神、意念，乃至虚无缥缈的第六感，尽数被滔天仙火点燃！
不过半息之间，一切便被焚烧殆尽，连一声哀嚎都未能传出。
哗！
在神圣浩瀚的仙光之中，一盏生有八瓣莲台、散发着淡淡清辉的古朴宝灯，凭空凝结浮现。
“那是...菩提心灯？！”
沈秋瞪大了双眼，心中闪过一连串问号。
明明就在不久前，万烬生为了苟全性命，已将这尊大罗仙宝彻底引爆，可为何它又出现在了沈云手里？
“这就是造化大道的威能吗？”
连见多识广的苍昊，此刻也不禁叹为观止。
亲眼目睹这神乎其技的手段，他心中忽然生出一个惊人的预感——大衍神尊诸天第一人的宝座，恐怕很快就要易主了。
......
...
一时间，沈云施展出无上妙道，生生将万烬生打回原形，重新炼化为菩提心灯。
“唔，好像还少了点什么....”
他目光微动，凝视着那光秃秃的灯芯，忽然灵光一闪。
content_en:
The two masterminds behind the scenes are full of bad ideas, but they are only honest.
As soon as they heard Shen Yun's tone, they knew: the matter had been exposed, and what awaited them would be an irreversible disaster.
"At this critical moment of life and death just now, I was really confused and obsessed for a moment!"
Holy Son Yuxu's face changed on the spot, his body suddenly hunched down, and he nodded and bowed: "Please, for the sake of the Immortal Lord, please forgive me next time. From now on, I will definitely change my mind and repay today's sins a hundred times."
He really had no choice but to mention the name of Yuxu Immortal Lord, without looking at the monk's face but at the Buddha's face, in an attempt to make Shen Yun look up to him.
On the other side, Wan Jinsheng also lowered his proud head and said continuously: "If I remember correctly, these deceased people were strangers to you, and there is no deep hatred between you and me."
At this point, he changed the topic and his tone suddenly became solemn: "I'm afraid you are still kept in the dark about something. The Nine Heavens Immortal Lord has personally invited Wan to plot against you outside the imperial mausoleum!"
"As long as you let me go today, Wan is willing to abandon the dark side and turn to the bright side to help you deal with Jiuxiao Immortal Lord together. How about that?"
There are no eternal friends, only eternal interests.
Wan Jinsheng knew this well and tried to use benefits to impress Chen Yun so as to cling to this small life.
It has to be said that his calculations were very precise - if it were other powerful immortals, a few unrelated ants would not be as important as getting rid of the enemy.
What a pity, who is Shen Yun?
He has his own way of doing things, how can he join in the evil deeds?
"When Ling Jiuxiao is ready, I will fight to the death with him."
Chen Yun looked calm and cast his deep gaze to the sky, as if he was talking about a trivial matter: "Whether it is the help of the Holy Sect or the protection of the God, after this battle, his fate will be over."
In the past, Chen Yun was still young and needed to keep a low profile and deal with this peerless enemy.
Now that he has achieved great success, if he still relies on such cheap means to win, he might as well just go back to seclusion in the mountains and forests. What else is there to cultivate?
"I won't make it difficult for you... From now on, you can become a magic weapon again."
Chen Yun flicked his sleeves and reached out to grab Wan Jinsheng, neatly and swiftly.
Bang!
This unparalleled genius, who was ranked among the Five Elites and was half-stepped, didn't even have time to think about it. He was captured on the spot and slipped in mid-air like a dead dog.
"What on earth are you going to do?!"
Wan Jinsheng was filled with panic, and the calm image he had previously created was instantly shattered, and he asked in panic.
The only thing that responded to him was the roaring fire of creation!
Huh-huh-
In an instant, the holy body, soul, thoughts, and even the illusory sixth sense that were born from embers were all ignited by the monstrous fairy fire!
But in just half a breath, everything was burned to the ground, and not even a wailing sound could be heard.
Wow!
In the vast divine light, a simple lamp with an eight-petal lotus platform and a faint brilliance condensed and emerged out of thin air.
"That's...the Bodhi Heart Lamp?!"
Shen Qiu's eyes widened, and a series of questions flashed through his heart.
Obviously not long ago, Wan Jinsheng completely detonated this Daluo Immortal Treasure in order to save his life, but why did it appear in Chen Yun's hands again?
"Is this the power of the Avenue of Creation?"
Even the well-informed Cang Hao couldn't help but be amazed at this moment.
Witnessing this miraculous method with his own eyes, he suddenly had an astonishing premonition in his heart - the throne of God Dayan, the number one person in the world, might soon change hands.
...
...
For a moment, Chen Yun displayed the supreme magic, knocking all the embers back to their original form and re-refining them into the Bodhi Heart Lamp.
"Well, it seems like something is missing..."
His eyes moved slightly, staring at the bare wick, and suddenly an idea flashed through him.
